scope: Two sequential instrumented 240-second Windows Vulkan Forward+ runs, 1280x720, normal speed, same six routes with six seconds of battle per visit. These are phase diagnostics below the 600-second acceptance duration.
timing: Previous frame post signal to first physics or idle signal, physics to idle signal, idle to pre-draw signal, and pre-draw to post-draw signal. All are wall-time boundaries. The Windows process and primary thread counters are independently sampled at nominal 5 ms and quantized. Measured bracket values can include CPU before or after a boundary. Godot draw signals give no exclusive GPU or subsystem time.

native_activity_counter_fix.reason: The local compiled-package runner converted SceneTree identifiers to Node calls using a textual substitution. It also converted the earlier activity snapshot string key, so older native activity.physics_steps counters cannot be read as per-visit deltas. Independently measured rendering and play_frame_trace.physics_steps are unaffected by that key.
